decisions.briefing: Stocks fell broadly today: the NASDAQ dropped 2.5% and the S&P 500 lost 1.9%, so the screener flagged the market as risk-off and returned no buy candidates. We are holding all seven positions and keeping the $545.88 in cash. The automatic stop-loss (-7%) and profit-target (+12%) rules will handle any position that hits its limit.

market_education.summary_en: Both major U.S. indexes fell sharply today: the NASDAQ dropped 2.5% and the S&P 500 lost 1.9%, a broad risk-off move in which investors sold riskier assets. The NASDAQ fell more than the S&P 500, which usually means growth and technology stocks took the most selling pressure. No news headlines were provided today, so no specific cause can be cited, but drops this size across the market tend to come from economy-wide worries rather than news about a single company.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面受壓，納斯達克指數下挫2.5%，標普500指數亦跌1.9%，市場明顯轉向避險，資金撤離高風險資產。納指跌幅大於標普，反映成長股及科技股首當其衝，承受最大沽壓。由於今日未有相關新聞資料，暫無法指出具體觸發因素；惟如此幅度的普跌，通常源於宏觀層面的憂慮，而非個別企業消息。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off describes a market mood in which investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like growth stocks, moving money into safer places such as cash or bonds. On days like this, prices tend to fall across the board, so buying new stocks is riskier because the drop may continue. Many disciplined investors pause new purchases and let their existing safety rules, such as stop-losses, protect them.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」（Risk-Off）是指投資者轉趨審慎，拋售成長股等高風險資產，轉而持有現金或債券等較穩健的資產。在這類交易日，大市往往普遍下跌，此時貿然建倉風險較高，因為跌勢或會延續。不少紀律嚴明的投資者會暫停買入，並依靠止蝕等既定風控機制保障現有持倉。
